study type: Mixed-methods quasi-experimental impact evaluation using a difference-in-differences approach with population-based household survey data and qualitative data.
outcome: Antenatal care (ANC) utilization (at least four ANC visits)
cohort: Women residing in treatment and matched comparison areas across three provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
finding: The health systems strengthening program significantly increased the probability of facility-based delivery, but had no significant impact on receiving at least four antenatal care visits.
cross-section timing: Population-based household surveys conducted at baseline (2014) and endline (2017).
